Landed bounded worker pool in new synchrotron-reconcile crate. Single-dispatcher task over Mutex<State> + Notify wakeups, per-app FIFO queues (HashMap<app_id, VecDeque<JobCtx>>) with ready/in_flight sets, global concurrency cap, per-app queue cap returning EnqueueError::QueueFull, shutdown awaits in-flight handlers. Exposes PoolStats (enqueued/rejected/started/completed/in_flight/queue_depth/total_wait_micros). 9 tokio tests cover per-app FIFO, cross-app concurrency, global cap, queue-full, shutdown rejection+drain, stats, interleaved bursts.

Landed pure planner + reconcile wrapper. plan.rs: pure plan(desired, live) -> Plan returning sorted PlanEntry list with PlannedAction::{Apply, Delete, NoOp}, identity by (Gvk, namespace, name), YAML-body equality for drift check (smarter diff stripping server-side fields is a later slice). reconcile.rs: Reconciler with DesiredSource/LiveSource traits (sync, backed by AppCache + informer cache in prod), reconcile_app(app, cluster) fetches both, calls plan, always publishes SystemEvent::SyncOutcome (success or failure message). SourceError::NotFound maps to ReconcileError::AppNotFound/ClusterNotFound for graceful missing-app/cluster handling. 14 unit tests (7 plan + 7 reconcile) covering no-drift, drift, create, delete, mixed, namespace identity, order independence, missing-app, missing-cluster, desired/live fetch failures.

Landed event-driven trigger. worker_pool: refactored enqueue into shared enqueue_impl(coalesce), added WorkerPool::enqueue_coalesce + cloneable PoolHandle (producer-side handle so triggers/schedulers enqueue without owning lifecycle). trigger.rs: AppResolver trait for repo→apps lookup, EventTrigger::spawn draining EventBus in a tokio task, mapping RepoChanged→Trigger::Poll and WebhookTriggered→Trigger::Webhook; RepoUnchanged/RepoFetchFailed/SyncOutcome ignored. Coalescing via PoolHandle::enqueue_coalesce (skip if app already pending/in-flight, since the next reconcile will observe the latest desired state anyway). 5 integration tests: repo-change fans out to mapped apps, webhook tags trigger correctly, rapid bursts coalesce to single enqueue, unrelated events no-op, unknown repos no-op. Total 28 tests in crate.

Landed periodic auto-heal scheduler. AutoHealConfig (default interval 180s, jitter_fraction 0.1) + AppLister trait. AutoHealScheduler::spawn runs a task that sleeps(interval) then ticks — per tick, iterates apps and enqueue_coalesce(AutoHeal) each with per-app delay = interval*jitter_fraction/N for deterministic uniform spread (no RNG needed, load-spreading is the goal). Skip-while-in-flight is automatic via enqueue_coalesce; a dedicated 'skipped' counter tracks how much auto-heal work was redundant with event-driven reconciles. AutoHealStats exposes ticks/enqueued/skipped. 5 tests: first tick fires after interval with AutoHeal tag, in-flight apps skipped + counted, empty app list still ticks, jitter spacing observable in enqueue timestamps, ticks counter increments over time. Total 33 tests in crate.

Trailing debouncer with per-app generation counter lands in crates/synchrotron-reconcile/src/debounce.rs. Wraps PoolHandle; bursts within the window collapse to one enqueue_coalesce call. Latest-wins trigger tag documented. 7 tests (single/burst/latest-wins/per-app-independence/flush_now/flush+timer-no-double/property). 40 tests passing in the crate.

Sync-wave ordering lands in crates/synchrotron-reconcile/src/wave.rs. wave_of() reads synchrotron.io/sync-wave (fallback argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave), default 0. group_into_waves() splits a Plan into ascending WaveGroups using desired-or-live annotations (so deletes inherit wave too). execute_waves() runs Applier per entry, then polls HealthChecker until Healthy or per-wave timeout fires WaveExecError::WaveTimeout. NoOp-only waves skip the health check. 12 tests including 3-wave integration, health gating, timeout abort, apply failure, deletes via live, negative/garbage/argo-key annotations. 52 tests passing in the crate.
